lines.text: The word of the LORD came to Jonah a second time, and this time he went to Nineveh.
Nineveh was so great that it required a seven-day journey, and Jonah proclaimed forty more days until it would be overturned.
The Ninevites believed God, proclaimed a fast, and dressed in sackcloth, from the greatest of them to the least.
The king of Nineveh left his throne, took off his royal robe, covered himself with sackcloth, and sat in the temple courts.
When God saw that they had turned from their evil ways, He relented from the disaster He had threatened.
